content: GitHub-hosted Linux arm64 runners (ubuntu-24.04-arm, ubuntu-22.04-arm, Ampere Altra) are free and unlimited for public repositories since Jan 2025 announcement (github.com/orgs/community/discussions/73040); billed only for private repos. macOS runners: macos-13=amd64, macos-14/15=arm64. So a 4-way Linux/macOS x amd64/arm64 matrix costs nothing on a public repo.
